description: This file contains functions for managing network model queries related to WAN mode, physical interfaces, and interface status, including creating, cleaning, and handling callbacks for queries in a network management system.

methods.name: ll_queries_clean
methods.description: Cleans up and frees memory for a linked list of query info structures.

methods.name: nm_query_response_phys_up_cb
methods.description: Callback for physical interface up/down status query; notifies autosensing if physical reference is not used.

methods.name: nm_query_create_phys_up_query
methods.description: Creates a query to monitor physical interface status.

methods.name: nm_query_response_ll_cb
methods.description: Callback for lower layer query; updates lower_layer info and signals found link layer.

methods.name: nm_query_create_ll_query
methods.description: Creates a query to get the first parameter of the interface, typically the interface path.

methods.name: nm_query_response_name_cb
methods.description: Callback for interface name query; updates interface name and triggers creation of lower layer query.

methods.name: wan_mode_up
methods.description: Checks if all interfaces in a WAN mode are up.

methods.name: nm_query_mode_active_handle_flags
methods.description: Handles setting or clearing netmodel flags and manages autosensing based on WAN mode activity.

methods.name: nm_query_mode_active_cb
methods.description: Callback for IPv4 mode active status; updates flags and autosensing.

methods.name: nm_query_mode6_active_cb
methods.description: Callback for IPv6 mode active status; updates flags and autosensing.

methods.name: nm_query_create_name_query
methods.description: Creates a query to resolve interface names based on WAN mode and flags.

methods.name: nm_query_ll_add
methods.description: Adds linked list queries for a WAN mode, including physical type and interface name queries.

methods.name: intf_isup_queries_clean
methods.description: Cleans up interface is-up queries and frees memory.

methods.name: init_intf_isup_query
methods.description: Initializes interface is-up query parameters for IPv4 or IPv6.

methods.name: open_intf_isup_query
methods.description: Opens a query to monitor if an interface is up for IPv4 or IPv6.

methods.name: nm_query_mode_active
methods.description: Creates queries to monitor if WAN modes are active and interfaces are up.

methods.name: nm_close_sensing_queries
methods.description: Closes all active sensing queries for current WAN modes and resets interface flags.
